admin_forbidden_hint: Reload the page to sign in again. If it still shows this, ask an admin to add your email.
admin_access_manual_add: Cloudflare Access doesn't let {email} in, and Orbs couldn't change that: the server has no Cloudflare token, or Cloudflare refused. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Zero Trust › Access controls › Policies, edit the team's allow policy (orbs-<team>-allow), add {email} under Include › Emails and save.
admin_access_manual_remove: Orbs already refuses {email}, but Cloudflare Access still sends them sign-in codes. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Zero Trust › Access controls › Policies, edit the team's allow policy (orbs-<team>-allow), remove {email} and save.
admin_access_not_allowed_hint: Cloudflare Access doesn't let this email in, so they can't sign in.
admin_access_unknown_hint: The panel can't check who Cloudflare Access lets in: the server has no Cloudflare token, or Cloudflare didn't answer.
admin_access_domain: Anyone with an {domains} address can request a sign-in code; only the people listed here and the admins get in.
admin_users_hint: Each user has their own workspace. Open a user to set up their settings and bots.
admin_users_empty_hint: Add a user to create their workspace and let them sign in.
admin_user_email_hint: The email they sign in with.
admin_user_create_hint: Creates the user's workspace and lets this email sign in.
admin_user_create_failed: Couldn't create the user. Check the email isn't already in use and try again.
admin_user_remove_description: {email} can no longer sign in and their workspace stops. Their data is kept on the server; deleting it is a separate server command.
admin_user_remove_failed: Couldn't remove the user. Try again.
admin_user_unreachable_hint: It may be stopped or still starting. Try again in a moment.
admin_user_devices_hint: Browsers and phones this user has signed in with. Revoking one signs it out.
admin_limits_hint: How much this person's workspace accepts before it asks to slow down. The defaults suit almost everyone; raise a limit only if this person sees "too many requests".
admin_limits_device: Requests per minute from each device
admin_limits_device_hint: For each signed-in browser or phone. Default 600.
admin_limits_public_hint: Everything that reaches this workspace through the hub counts here. Default 6000.
admin_limits_redeem_hint: Tries at a pairing code. Keep this low. Default 10.
admin_limits_watch: Live updates at the same time
admin_limits_watch_hint: Open chats and lists that update by themselves. Default 64.
admin_limits_failed: Couldn't save the limits. Check that each value is within its allowed range, then try again.
admin_admins_hint: People who can open this panel. An admin doesn't need to be a user and has no workspace.
admin_admins_add_failed: Couldn't add the admin. Try again.
admin_admins_remove_description: They can no longer open this panel. If they are also a user, their own workspace stays.
admin_admins_remove_failed: Couldn't remove the admin. Try again.
admin_admins_last: The last admin can't be removed.
admin_user_bots: Bots to create (suggested bots from Global settings)
admin_global_hint: Applies to everyone who has not overridden a section.
admin_global_bots_hint: Offered, all ticked, when you add a user. Each user gets their own copy, independent of these afterwards.
admin_global_starting_hint: Global settings can be edited once it is running.
admin_global_missing_hint: Run apply on the server to create it. Until then, users keep their current settings.
admin_global_status_hint: Which sections each user overrides, and whether the last copy of the global values worked.
admin_global_sync_failed: Couldn't start the sync. Try again.
admin_section_override_failed: Couldn't override the section. Try again.
admin_section_back_description: This person's own {section} settings will be replaced by the global values.
admin_section_back_failed: Couldn't switch back to global. Try again.
admin_section_back_checking: Checking what this person would lose…
admin_section_back_unreachable: This person's workspace or the global settings didn't answer, so the list can't be shown. Make sure both are running, then try again.
admin_section_back_nothing: Nothing will be lost: this person's {section} settings already match global.
admin_section_back_changed: Will be replaced with the global value
admin_section_back_replaced: Their own secret will be replaced by the global one with the same name
admin_section_back_replaced_models: Global's key will be used instead of the key in this person's models.json (the file itself stays as it is)
admin_section_back_too_large_title: Their ~/.agents folder is too large to list
admin_section_back_too_large: It has more than 2000 files or 6 MiB, so the files in it aren't listed below. Switching back to global still works: it replaces the whole folder with the global files.
admin_section_back_stale: Something changed since this list was made. Check the updated list and confirm again.
admin_section_back_models_limit: Account sign-ins (OAuth) and models.json are not part of global settings, and models.json is never changed. A sign-in stays unless global has a key for the same provider.
admin_section_back_secrets_limit: Secrets this person added themselves stay and aren't listed, except one with the same name as a global secret.
admin_section_back_sources_limit: Inside ~/.agents, what global can't copy (node_modules, .git and symlinks) is removed too and isn't listed.
admin_section_global_hint: Read-only: this section follows the global settings.
admin_section_refused: This section follows global settings for this person. Override it first, or change it under Global settings.
admin_bots_copy_hint: The ticked bots are copied from Global settings. The copies are independent afterwards.
admin_bots_copy_failed: Couldn't add the bots. Try again.
admin_conversations_hint: Read this person's conversations with their bots. Reading leaves no trace in their app: nothing is marked read and they get no notification.
admin_conversations_empty_hint: This person has no bots to chat with yet.
admin_conversations_template_empty_hint: Nobody chats in the template workspace. Each person's copy of a suggested bot has its own conversation.
admin_conversations_pick_hint: Pick a bot to read its conversation with this person.
admin_conversations_no_messages_hint: This person hasn't chatted with this bot.
admin_conversations_missing_hint: The bot may have been deleted. Choose another conversation.
admin_conversations_artifact_read_only: Read only: what you change here is not saved and the person doesn't see it.
admin_conversations_artifact_gone: This version is no longer kept. Pick another version.
admin_conversations_waiting_approval_hin: {bot} asked to do this. Only the person can answer, in their app.
admin_conversations_waiting_answer_hint: {bot} asked this. Only the person can answer, in their app.
admin_activity_hint: What admins read and changed, newest first. Only who, what and where are kept, never what anyone wrote or a value an admin saved.
admin_activity_empty_hint: Reads and changes made in the admin panel appear here.
admin_activity_empty_filtered_hint: Try other filters, or clear them to see everything.
admin_user_advanced_hint: Shows this person the advanced settings in their app: chat preferences, model providers, the Jev key and sources. Permissions, approval rules and how bots use secrets stay with you.
admin_user_advanced_failed: Couldn't change the advanced setting. Try again.
